2608.07092.title: International Transfer of Stochastic Cortical Self-Reconstruction
2608.07092.paper_summary: Stochastic cortical self-reconstruction (SCSR) enables personalized mapping of gray matter atrophy, a hallmark of neurodegenerative disorders such as Alzheimer's disease (AD), onto high-resolution cortical surfaces. Unlike conventional normative modeling approaches, which typically operate at a coarse regional level and remain inherently constrained by the covariates included during training, SCSR estimates an individualized healthy reference directly from the observed cortical thickness at the vertex level. This allows the detection of subtle, subject-specific deviations from healthy cortical shape. In this work, we investigate the generalization and transferability of SCSR, originally trained on UK Biobank (UKB) data, to an independent Chinese population dataset. Specifically, we evaluate the ability of SCSR-derived Z-scores to discriminate between healthy scans, individuals with mild cognitive impairment (MCI), and patients with AD, while also assessing model robustness across the lifespan. We compare four training strategies: direct application of the UKB-trained model, fine-tuning on Chinese data, training from scratch, and joint training on UKB and Chinese cohorts. As reconstruction backbones, we consider both a multilayer perceptron (MLP) and a Spherical UNet (SUNet). Our results demonstrate that SCSR provides robust detection of cortical atrophy in the Chinese population across all evaluated models. The highest discriminative performance was achieved by the fine-tuned SUNet model (average pairwise AUC = 0.848), followed closely by the UKB-trained SUNet. Moreover, reconstruction errors remained low across the lifespan, even when the training population exhibited a substantially narrower age distribution, indicating strong cross-population transferability.
2608.07092.paper_summary_zh: 隨機皮質自我重建（SCSR）使得能夠個性化地映射灰質萎縮，這是阿茲海默症（AD）等神經退行性疾病的標誌，並將其映射到高解析度的皮質表面。與傳統的標準建模方法不同，後者通常在粗略的區域層面運作，並在訓練過程中受到所包含協變量的固有限制，SCSR 直接從觀察到的頂點層次皮質厚度估算個體化的健康參考。這使得能夠檢測出與健康皮質形狀的微妙、特定於個體的偏差。在這項工作中，我們調查了 SCSR 的泛化能力和可轉移性，該模型最初在英國生物銀行（UKB）數據上進行訓練，現在應用於獨立的中國人群數據集。具體而言，我們評估了 SCSR 衍生的 Z 分數在區分健康掃描、輕度認知障礙（MCI）個體和阿茲海默症患者方面的能力，同時評估模型在整個生命週期中的穩健性。我們比較了四種訓練策略：直接應用 UKB 訓練的模型、在中國數據上進行微調、從頭開始訓練以及在 UKB 和中國隊列上進行聯合訓練。作為重建骨幹，我們考慮了多層感知器（MLP）和球形 UNet（SUNet）。我們的結果顯示，SCSR 在所有評估的模型中都能夠穩健地檢測中國人群的皮質萎縮。微調的 SUNet 模型達到了最高的區分性能（平均成對 AUC = 0.848），緊隨其後的是 UKB 訓練的 SUNet。此外，即使訓練人群的年齡分佈顯著較窄，重建誤差在整個生命週期中仍然保持在低水平，這表明了強大的跨人群可轉移性。
